answer_format: End your reply with a final line that contains \boxed{<number>}.

rules.normalize_answer: src/math_task.py module doc, 'Numeric rule' steps 1-4: decorations removed, then an integer, decimal, \frac/\dfrac/\tfrac or slash fraction; canonical reduced 'p/q' or 'p'
rules.strict: normalize_answer of the content of the last complete \boxed{...} (bbh.boxed_contents); None without a box or when the content is not a number
rules.lenient: normalize_answer of the last match of the lenient pattern after '{,}' and LaTeX thin-space thousands are read as commas
rules.length: numbers of any length are read exactly (Python's 4,300-digit limit on integer conversion is lifted inside normalize_answer)
